outputs.prompt:
Design a polished, readable in-game UI art mockup for SCRAPWORKS, based on the supplied real game screenshot and its existing title logo. This is a visual proposal only.
STYLE REFERENCE: the title logo is the authoritative identity. Its warm pale cream face planes, ink navy extruded sides, coral-orange repair pieces, olive leaf green, angular chipped silhouettes and clean flat painted finish must become a coherent UI family. Palette: cream #F1E1BD, highlight #FFF1CF, deep navy #142C40, steel blue #31495D, coral #F08A65, leaf green #8FA653. Preserve a modest amount of thick dark edge separation like the logo, but eliminate thin continuous outlined rounded boxes.
SHAPES AND DEPTH: front-facing panels constructed from 2–3 broad salvaged plates. Straight mostly rectangular sides with clipped, nicked or asymmetric corners; zero pill shapes and no rounded-card system. Gentle 1–2 degree misalignment of backing plates and a few title/button plates. Keep body text, grid cells and interaction alignment level and disciplined. Show 6–10px solid navy lower-right extrusion, a narrow pale top bevel and selective painted shadow planes. Use only a few coral repair tabs or metal fasteners at structural joins. Broad simple colours, very restrained wear at corners, no photographic rust, grunge noise, glossy chrome, glow, busy steampunk gears or pervasive hazard stripes.
READABILITY: sturdy slightly irregular squared display lettering for titles; clean highly readable humanist sans for labels and paragraphs. All text horizontal, crisp and high contrast. Cream text on dark content wells, navy text on cream plates, navy text on coral primary buttons. Primary action coral; secondary actions cream or subdued steel; positive progress leaf green with icon and label. Reserve clean blank room for status so controls feel stable. The only gear-and-leaf motif should be subtle and occasional, never decorative clutter.
SCREENSHOT CONSTRAINT: keep the actual world/background and its camera composition recognisable from the screenshot. Restyle UI, do not redesign terrain, machinery or the protagonist. No browser frame, no presentation slide margins, no annotations or invented marketing copy. Output a finished high-resolution landscape 16:10 UI screen.
TARGET: redesign the supplied Inventory & Crafting Field kit screen. Enlarge the field kit modestly so its full content is readable, about 1160 by 720 relative to a 1600 by 1000 screen. Keep the green prototype game world visible around it, softly dimmed. Preserve the three functional columns and left-to-right hierarchy: Inventory, Handcrafting, Mini Fabricator. Title 'Field kit' on a slightly crooked cream metal header; top-right 'Save progress' and 'Close'. Four attached irregular tab plates: 'Inventory & Crafting' selected in cream/coral, 'Research', 'Factory', 'Field manual'. Content wells are dark navy, not cream.
Inventory: 24 inset square slots arranged four columns by six rows, aligned; label '6/24 slots'. Use simple flat item pictograms and short labels matching the screenshot: Pipe 2, Mixed scrap 72, Mixed scrap 100, Mixed scrap 100, Mixed scrap 100, Power 7. Other slots empty. No new gameplay resources or currencies.
Handcrafting: title, compact guidance 'Keep the field kit open while crafting.', Recipe select 'Scrap prybar', a recipe strip '4 Mixed scrap → 1 Scrap prybar', '4 s per unit', Batch size control 1, raised coral 'Handcraft 1' button, reserved status 'No handcraft in progress'.
Mini Fabricator: 'Request completed', 'Power-free baseline · 2× charged speed', charge readout '24.0 / 60 active boost seconds', broad recessed segmented green/coral charge strip, a single chunky winding crank disk (circular only because it is a physical crank), short hint 'Turn to charge'. Substantial navy button sides and offset panel backplate should make this scrappy family visibly related to the logo, with controlled asymmetry and uncluttered content.
